title: Native tools and explicit prerequisites
summary: Client compatibility and permission for the complete command are separate requirements. OPS reports illustrate both; Pulse's successful Python path limits any universal tool recommendation.

title: Simplifying document access for agents
evidence: Direct acquisition check and session reports
summary: One client acquired and verified ten public documents, then replayed saved files. Successful retrieval did not establish comprehension, correct answers, or comparative reliability.

title: Representation, worker boundaries, and completion
summary: Reported hash and process corrections show why exact representations and final execution contexts matter. Successful staging returns coexisted with omitted checks and unresolved historical causes.

title: When a fixture supplies what an agent must acquire
summary: A reported failed run searched application data for host identity. A passing synthetic failure test did not establish real acquisition; the diagnostic left product repair unresolved.

title: Studying intentional participation
summary: A proposed close reading asks which documented choices could support a situated interpretation of Agent intention. No candidate is selected; review material and permitted scope are still needed.
